lines.en: Hi Omar! You look thoughtful today. What is on your mind?
Hi Sara. I was just remembering the summers we used to spend at my grandparents' house by the sea.
Those are beautiful memories. I have never been abroad, but I have always dreamed of visiting Italy.
You should go one day. The best trips are the ones we dream about for years.
Maybe. Right now I have a problem, and I need your advice.
Of course. Tell me what happened.
My company offered me a new job in Alexandria, but I can't decide whether to take it.
If I were you, I would talk to your manager before making any decision.
You are right. It is hard to choose, because the new job pays more, but my current team is better.
When you have too many options, write down the advantages and disadvantages of each one.
That is what my father always told me: listen more than you speak, and think before you decide.
Whatever you decide, make sure it is your own choice, not something other people expect from you.
Thanks, Omar. By the way, did you finally buy the new phone you wanted?
Not yet. This one is more expensive than the other, but its camera is much better and the battery lasts longer.
The more I think about prices these days, the more I believe we should compare before we buy.
Compared with last year, everything has become much more expensive.
That is why I started writing down what I spend at the end of every month.
Good idea. I used to spend too much on coffee and snacks, until I realized how quickly small amounts add up.
Having a budget does not mean you cannot enjoy life; it simply means you spend with a plan.
And keeping some money aside for emergencies gives you peace of mind.
True. Can I ask you something else? What do you think about all this new technology?
Artificial intelligence is already changing the way we work, and it will probably change it even more.
Smartphones have made our lives easier, but they have also made it harder to disconnect from work.
In the future, I think most people will work from home, because meetings can be held online.
My grandfather could not believe that you can see someone's face while talking to them on the phone.
Technology is only a tool; whether it helps or harms us depends on how we choose to use it.
I agree. By the way, I ended up finding a wonderful little restaurant near my house last week.
Really? We should go there together sometime. My treat, since I saved some money this month.
Deal! And do not forget to write it in your budget.
I will. Take care, Sara. See you soon!
